```{r global, include=FALSE}
library(PharmaStatsR)
```

## Simulated enrollment

This chart draws random counts when rendered. It does not use study data or
provide an interim monitoring or stopping decision.

```{r}
renderPlot({
  plot(cumsum(rbinom(100, 1, 0.05)), type = "l",
       xlab = "Day", ylab = "Participants",
       main = "Simulated Enrollment Over Time")
})
```
